L.N. 61 of 2026
VARIOUS LAWS RELATING TO CORPORATE
SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2026
(ACT No. I of 2026)
Commencement Notice
IN EXERCISE of the powers conferred by article 1(2) of the
Various Laws relating to Corporate Sustainability Reporting
(Amendment) Act, 2026, the Minister responsible for the registration
of commercial partnerships has established the date of the publication
of this Legal Notice as the date on which the provisions of articles 17,
26, 27, 28, 29, 31, 41 and 42 of the said Act shall come into force.
